title: great lingerie washing bags
text: great lingerie washing bags. I love that these bags come in white and in black... easy to figure out which bag to use with the light delicate and the dark delicate.  I just wish they would have used a white zipper on the white bags!  I have used the white bag and it didn't appear to bleed color on my light delicate, so that's good.  I always update my reviews when new info would be helpful.
